Hint 1: Consider how the Mean Cubed Error loss function behaves differently from the Mean Squared Error. Think about how the cubic term affects the penalty for errors that are larger versus those that are smaller.

Hint 2: Analyze the impact of the cubic power on the error term. Remember that cubing a number amplifies its magnitude, especially for values greater than $$1$$ or less than $$-1$$. Consider how this affects the loss for predictions that are closer or farther from their true target values.
